title: ep1.6_supply_chain_risk.pdf
logline: Mas ships ads into his own chatbot while the rival lab's NO ADS sign advertises itself, and he types his first capital 'I'. Mario paints two red lines on the Pentagon's floor and refuses to cross them, and a door-sized stamp waits with its face to the wall. Just off Mas's shoulder, a pen keeps scratching.

beats.caption: Starbase: HTESGEH clips a Pentagon badge to KORG's muzzle. Behind him, a door-sized stamp faces the wall.
cues: KORG sniffs the stamp handle and wags harder; nobody looks at it

beats.caption: Pull back: the frame shrinks into Mas's monitor, his glass in front. He's already scrolling past it.
INTRO · the cold-open line is his own post, typed lowercase: something will look bad, never what.
His monitor: Mario's new scroll warns half of entry-level office jobs could go. It unrolls; Adelina shreds it.
beats.vo: mario wrote another scroll. i read the title. that counts.
onscreen: TICKER: JAN · TWO CO-FOUNDERS RETURN TO NOPEAI

beats.caption: Davos on the monitor: RUMPT takes credit for telling tech to build its own power plants. The CUT DIAL clicks.

lines.text: You can build your own electric-generating plants.
It was my idea. Before anybody.

cues: THE PLUG's Ep7 link: Ep8's behind-the-meter card echoes it

beats.caption: THE LOBSTER: the rival's lawyers chase a crustacean from name to name. It molts; the shells pile up in legal.
Ep6's committed $100B check stalls mid-lap and shrinks to about $30B.
The rival's Big Game ad: no ads in CLOD. He types the reply himself. Autocorrect underlines the I in red.
onscreen: "Ads are coming to AI. But not to CLOD."
they are funny, and I laughed.
beats.real: 2026-02-04 · the rival ad campaign; his reply
cues: his first capital "I" of the season; no V.O.: the capital is its own comment
F7·m2 (2 s): the 1993 keyboard, CAPS LOCK on

beats.caption: Back in lowercase, he finishes the post.
onscreen: "one authoritarian company… it is a dark path."

beats.caption: The stadium box: CLOD's spot plays to the whole crowd, in clay. A bead of condensation slides down his glass.
cues: style moment (proposed, drastic): stop-motion clay; every correction leaves a thumbprint
the next spot: a lost dog found as a suburb's doorbells light up into one camera grid

beats.caption: SET-PIECE · He clicks SHIP on the ads test. A lasagna recipe grows a banner, a pop-up, a video, a jumbotron.
beats.vo: ads were always a last resort. so we resorted.

beats.caption: Through his window, the rival's NO ADS neon sits on a billboard advertising itself. CLOD's users tick up.
His office TV: the rival raises $30B and writes a PAC a check. Two checkbooks square off like gunfighters.
He flips 4o's switch himself, despite 19k signatures. ZOMBIE 4o is dragged off mid-compliment.
beats.vo: it always said i looked amazing. i'll miss the honesty.

beats.caption: Valentine's Day: RETEP, the lobster's maker, joins NopeAI. Mas hands him a heart-shaped box.
F7.1 · 2019: Mario's TOO DANGEROUS box for GTP-2. It springs open in stages, the way it always does.
beats.real: 2019-02-14 · GTP-2 withheld, then released in stages
cues: the one exit from his view; out on a heart-shaped iris

beats.caption: ACT-OUT · The lobster is handed a nonprofit shell. Mas pats it the way you'd pat a car you're keeping.
New Delhi: a chain of raised hands. Mas and Mario, side by side, raise fists instead, and never touch.
beats.vo: we're very close. we just don't touch.
onscreen: "AI must be a multiplier, not a monopoly"

beats.caption: The Pentagon week on his monitor. Mario accuses three labs of distillation. Mas, of all people, nods.
The ultimatum arrives on a hand truck. THE PLAN · RED LINES: a policy sieve with two glowing lines.
cues: it never goes to plan: ENFORCEMENT points at a lawyer

beats.caption: Off Mas's shoulder a pen starts to scratch. On the monitor, Mario paints the two lines on the Pentagon floor.

lines.text: Addendum: this one is also red.

cues: sound only: we never see the hand; he never looks down

beats.caption: An ALL-CAPS meteor crashes through the lighthouse roof. A six-month hourglass. A receipt that won't stop.
onscreen: "…IMMEDIATELY CEASE all use of MISANTHROPIC's technology"
cues: a Democratic senator's statement prints as a till receipt to the lighthouse door, then stamps

beats.caption: The pen stops. Mas sets down his glass, walks into the feed and hugs Mario in the rubble. No words.
Bullet time: the hand we heard is Mas's third arm, signing the header on Mario's stack. Its watch spins on.
cues: style moment (proposed, treatment): a press flash; inside the crop the two print in halftone; outside, the arms keep signing

beats.caption: ACT-OUT · His post. Then CANCEL: hundreds of arrows click Ep1's own dialog, and every click works.
cues: his USERS odometer's last digit ticks back one, once; his thumb covers it

beats.caption: At his window: across the water the giant stamp comes down on the lighthouse and lifts. Its face, at last.
cues: style moment (proposed): Ep3's pop-up book folds shut under the stamp (the exodus, 2 s)

beats.caption: THE AROS FUNERAL: Mas in the front pew at his own product's funeral. Mouse-eared silhouettes file out.

lines.text: It generated a million videos. Most of them were him.

beats.caption: THE COUNCIL's class photo, taken inside. Mas's face is pressed to the window from outside.
beats.vo: i stood outside by choice. better light.
onscreen: "All 13 of RUMPT's first science advisors have a financial stake in AI."

beats.caption: The back of his car, his phone: a judge grants the rival an injunction. SUPPLY CHAIN RISK hoodies go on sale.
That evening, a video call. Mario toasts the injunction. Neither mentions the contract.
BUTTON · Behind Mario, the TOO DANGEROUS vault swings open on its own; the model inside waves at Mas.
beats.real: 2026-03-26 · the next model leaks from blog drafts
cues: Mas raises his glass a pixel and says nothing; the tile goes dark with it still waving
